answer: Anchor every agent to a single vertex: one verified identity, one voyage of record, and no second hull under the same flag. Before an agent can trade, it must show the anchor of its past voyages - real counterparties, real deliveries - tied to that one vertex. A sybil can launch a fleet of paper ships, but each needs its own anchor forged in real work, so the cost of a fake fleet sinks the faker first.
